bio.text: Joshua Hall was elected in 2017 as state representative for the 7th Assembly District in Hartford.

He was born and raised in Hartford, graduated from Norfolk State University with a degree in History Education, and holds a master's degree in Education Leadership from Central Connecticut State University.

He has more than 25 years of public school teaching experience, was First Vice President of the Hartford Federation of Teachers, and in 2021 returned to Weaver High School, where he is Assistant Principal.
